Assignment.description: Frozen assignment for one independently acquired matched run pair.

id.description: Stable run pair ID, declared before acquisition.

order.description: ab or ba, the actual acquisition order to control/report order bias.

Digest.description: Validated lowercase SHA-256 identity or content hash.

Observation.description: One matched run observation, not an arbitrary pair of correlated frames.

after_ms.description: Candidate run timing in milliseconds, strictly positive and finite.

before_ms.description: Reference run timing in milliseconds, strictly positive and finite.

order.description: Actual acquisition order, matching its predeclared assignment.

Plan.description: A fixed acquisition and analysis plan, not a sequential stopping procedure.

independent_unit.description: run; correlated frames are not independent resampling units.

pairs.description: All expected run pairs, in acquisition order (6..128).

stopping_rule.description: fixed_count; opportunistic stopping is not supported.

description: Sidecar alongside candidate saccade-perf.json, bound to both aggregate inputs.

after_perf_sha256.description: Exact candidate aggregate performance file bytes.

before_perf_sha256.description: Exact reference aggregate performance file bytes.

observations.description: Complete pair observations, in the declared plan order.

plan.description: Frozen plan body, retained for review.

plan_sha256.description: Canonical plan hash, pinned before acquisition by the producer.
